nodeStatus.title: Node Status
nodeStatus.descriptionHtml: A node is considered Active if it maintains a 360-day position in the BarkX Pool. This means holding at least 1 VN and any amount of LP tokens configured for the 360-day locking cycle. Unlocked assets within this cycle still count towards the active status.

compoundEligibility.title: Compound Eligibility
compoundEligibility.metricHint: This metric represents the percentage of your total claimed BARKX rewards from BarkX Pool that have been reinvested into LP tokens.
compoundEligibility.rulesHtml: BarkAI evaluates this ratio for each user every 7 days. If your ratio is ≥ {threshold}% at the next snapshot, you will be awarded the Compound Medal, unlocking a yield multiplier valid for the subsequent 7 days.

incubator.title: Incubator
incubator.subtitle: vBARKX-BARKX Gateway
incubator.connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to view your incubation data.
incubator.normalInfo: Convert your injected vBARKX to BARKX based on your allocated quota. Any unused conversion quota for the day will be forfeited and does not roll over to the next day.
incubator.leaderInfo: Leader Incubator maps the daily conversion quota from the revenue data of the OpenDAO Node Signal Model and Node Feedback Model. On any given day, a node's Dynamic Reward and Feedback Reward are automatically mapped to its daily conversion quota in the Leader Incubator. If the daily conversion quota is unused, it will accumulate automatically.

inject.title: Inject vBARKX
inject.info: Inject your vBARKX to build your 30-day average balance. Daily snapshots taken at 00:45 UTC determine your share for the BARKX conversion quota in the next day.
inject.warning: Warning: Injection is irreversible. Injected vBARKX can only be converted, not withdrawn.

weightModal.title: OpenDAO Node Weight
weightModal.desc:
This value is securely fetched from the OpenDAO Partner API.

It acts as a multiplier applied directly to your 30-Day Average Injection. A higher weight factor significantly amplifies your competitive proportion in the daily snapshot, securing a larger share of the BARKX conversion quota.

dynamicModal.title: Dynamic Reward Mapping
dynamicModal.desc:
This value is securely fetched from the OpenDAO Partner API.

It acts as a factor to directly map your OpenDAO Dynamic Reward into the leader's incubation quota.

feedbackModal.title: Feedback Reward Mapping

penalty.title: Penalty Adjustment

protocol.title: Protocol Security Parameter
protocol.text: The aggregate yield multiplier is hard-capped at x2.00. Cumulative bonuses exceeding +100% are truncated to ensure network sustainability and adhere to the acceleration engine's strict risk management protocols.
